scope: Focused provenance and control-boundary check of existing Interface Atlas Agent Experience draft. No repository changes, code imports, skill imports, or full source refresh.
outcome: No factual or credit blocker found in the reviewed draft. Existing source/inference and historical/current boundaries are suitable for a practical fictional UI trial.

checks.limit: Protocol version 2025-11-25 only. This audit did not replace the pin or survey a newer protocol revision. No protocol source establishes application-wide proposal revision approval or steering application evidence.

recommendations: Proceed with a bounded fictional UI trial using the draft, preserving protocol-version and Atlas-proposal labels in its supporting design documentation.
Keep local notification dismissal separate from sending an elicitation dismissal response or cancelling execution; the practical UI should make each action's consequence visible.
For the trial, show cancellation requested, task status and effect evidence independently; a cancelled status cannot support a success claim that all work stopped or rolled back.
Keep submitted correction, acknowledgement and evidence of application separate. The fixture must state what service evidence exists rather than infer it from MCP request/task identity.
Use deliberate status announcements and stable focus; evaluate actual keyboard/assistive-technology behavior when a prototype exists.

Retain source credits and the pinned MIT notice. No additional copied upstream artifact or missing mandatory notice was identified within this audit's reviewed scope; future imports require artifact-specific terms review.
No need to refetch every cited source or expand the ledger for this trial. Preserve existing unresolved publication-license choice and avoid asserting a current PAIR edition or latest MCP behavior.
